annotations.title: Forward an app's events to a URL

description: Add a destination to an existing app: new events are forwarded to this URL, with retries, within about a minute, and the app's other destinations stay as they are. Adding a URL the app already has changes nothing. The signing secret for the AnyHook-Signature header is never returned here: the user gets it in the dashboard (the result says where).

api_key.description: Legacy field, ignored. Connect with ANYHOOK_API_KEY in the stdio client configuration.

appSlug.description: The app whose events should be forwarded.

url.description: Public https URL that receives each event as a POST.

name: anyhook_destination_add
title: Forward an app's events to a URL
